title: Add a per-user macOS Finder and Dock launcher
body:
Part of #456 and #326.

Adds a per-user `GraphGoblin.app` for Apple Silicon macOS 15 or later. The installer saves a built checkout and native Node 22 path. Finder and Dock launches verify or start that instance and open the default browser; closing the launcher or browser leaves gateway work running. Installation uses a private ownership receipt and atomic publication/replacement, refusing foreign or uncertain destinations.

GPT-authored Swift code owns readiness, process lifetime and filesystem admission. Actual Claude Code authored the AppKit progress, Hide, Quit, reopen and browser handoff. The API shares the bounded gateway log writer across Windows and Darwin and rechecks the Mac launcher's local key source after both writer leases. Existing Windows and instance protocol versions remain unchanged. This change adds no store-format change, updater, login item or PWA-window control.

### Current status — November 23 current-main integration

This PR remains **draft**, now at `504afbc6d799aa21b16158248ade424783ecc2ce` (tree `3bdfeac6dded28ac73d4796de86955a115fc56a6`), integrated with main `0f6c325becf3e3e0562ae69dfae2c42bcf1d7129`. [D237](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/pull/501#issuecomment-7089722988) records the isolated integration decision. The source merge `e2161f5d9b13f6701929fa67ef77329d4bb98945` preserves current release/reclamation/rollback behavior and Mac opened-inode attestation through one primary acquisition. Its following archive commit changes no application, package, installer, tooling, lockfile or CI input. Swift/AppKit and original native evidence remain unchanged.

[Current integration evidence](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/504afbc6d799aa21b16158248ade424783ecc2ce/docs/qa/2026-11-23-macos-main-integration/README.md) retains 135 byte-exact originals from 14 packets, including first failures and qualifications. Author checks passed 296 selected Windows cases with 27 explicit skips, API typecheck/lint and the repository build. Independent delta QA passed 13 newly designed public-interface cases plus 15 adjacent cases; 18 real POSIX cases remain unexecuted on Windows. Real Windows ownership/process evidence is distinguished from controlled uid/mode, unlink-fault and completion-barrier cases. These results establish only the stated integration delta.

[CI run 45104292980, attempt 1](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/actions/runs/45104292980) has been queued for this head and target, with all seven current jobs required. **No current CI pass is claimed.** Actual Claude opposing-family critique of the new integration, complete hosted native tests/coverage/acceptance, missing device-local Finder/alias/Dock/browser-close/replacement/restarted-history observations, and the reserved third/final Astra MAX audit remain required. Formal scans remain **2 of 3**. No new interactive Mac result is present in the retained public record; this does not establish whether work occurred in a device-local chat.

The original dependency-audit blocker is resolved: [CI14 attempt 2](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/actions/runs/44155824518/attempts/2) passed after the advisory withdrawal, as recorded in the [audit-resolution comment](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/pull/501#issuecomment-6989569927) and closed [#503](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/issues/503). The owner's seven-day exception was unused. Historical checks below bind their original heads and targets.

The owner [removed the Mac-first dependency](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/issues/279#issuecomment-6969001971); the five intents continue in their approved internal order. This changes no Mac gate, #460 hold, conditional refinement admission or post-merge owner acceptance.

### Historical candidate and validation

- Published head: `6fe12f412cd74b034a77cde10a521bb319e8aa96`; tree: `689d42d357f4c817cc904ced31cd0d3700b65146`; target: `6d7fcc9838d831fe1be3c3cf52c90a2f33e8f5b1`. Shipping launcher/API source remains identical to frozen product source `18089bba4b1c5f4fad19627d4c118b48b656a247`.
- [CI14, run 44155824518](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/actions/runs/44155824518) **failed only at the dependency-audit step** for this documentation/evidence-only publication. Browser passed 481 tests; Windows launcher passed 25; Mac API passed 203 with eight skipped; Swift passed 168. Shared coverage ran 9,839 passing tests with 50 skipped, and all 13 V8 summaries exceeded 90% lines and branches. Native coverage remains 3,492/3,627 lines (96.28%) and 1,868/2,056 regions (90.86%). Native installer/gateway and Template image acceptance passed. The overall run is not green: the high picomatch advisory is tracked in [#503](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/issues/503). Root verified no product, test, build or CI input changed from the passing CI13 head. Shipping source remains frozen.
- [CI13, run 44024381922](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/actions/runs/44024381922) **passed all five jobs** at previous head `4d72503321e587d7a36341462a49e442f3e51a6f`: Gates, Browser, Windows launcher, macOS launcher and Template image. All **168 Swift tests passed**, and complete native coverage is **3,492/3,627 lines (96.28%) and 1,868/2,056 regions (90.86%)**, with `meetsThreshold: true`. Native installer/gateway acceptance passed. All 13 V8 workspace summaries exceed 90% lines and branches. The test-only batch adds descriptor and input refusals, receipt validation, interrupted installer recovery, rollback and exact warm-peer failure checks. It changes no production source, coverage denominator, threshold, deadline or repository build settings.
- [CI12, run 44019677654](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/actions/runs/44019677654), at `53f41045`, passed Gates, Browser, Windows and Template. All 154 Swift tests, 203 API tests (eight skips) and native installer/gateway acceptance passed. Complete native coverage measured **3,439/3,627 lines (94.82%) and 1,775/2,056 regions (86.33%)**, so the approved region threshold correctly failed. Both zero and observed LLVM exports exited 0 with empty stderr. This is complete measurement, not a passing native gate.
- Local Node 22 syntax, lint, formatting, fixture controls and all 43 coverage-checker tests passed. All 57 current Swift package sources compiled and linked on the owner Mac in an isolated build with local CLT framework search paths; root verified their hashes. The focused local test attempt failed before execution because the installed CLT could not load a transitive Testing runtime library. No local native test pass is claimed.
- The owner Mac built the frozen product successfully: pnpm installation, all 12 application builds without cache, and both arm64 release builds. Engineering acceptance passed two tests and nine checkpoints, including malformed-locale installation, concurrent cold launches, replacement, ordinary shutdown and verified process/listener/lease release.
- Independent native QA06 met all 342 selected checks (243 hard, 99 soft) across S0–S7 and S9 on the frozen product. Its 225 evidence files were hash-verified. Actual Claude Code Opus 5.5 xhigh independently assessed the results and found no observed product defect. Optional S8 was not executed. Earlier failures and harness corrections remain recorded.
- The owner completed the first cold Finder launch and reported the correct destination after restarting a previously hung Chrome session. The original Mac Codex session completed a warm Finder check at 03:35:47 UTC November 17, then stalled during alias/Dock inspection. The owner stopped that turn. A fresh direct Codex CLI session resumed at 04:51:32 UTC, reverified the native instance and correct Chrome destination, exercised a provider-free waiting run, cancelled that exact run, checked ordinary token-guarded drain, and performed a managed same-path replacement. Final observation found the fixture stopped, both ports free and no leases.
- The earlier direct GUI attempt was blocked: Finder computer use was denied; Chrome subsequently failed with a native-pipe startup error. Actual Claude independently assessed the partial evidence, and root recorded the distinction between driver assertions and direct observations. Alias/Dock routing, browser-close continuity and restarted history/snapshot checks are still unverified. The current managed app must be the new baseline before another pre/post-replacement GUI sequence. The owner transferred remaining Mac work to a fresh session directly on the Mac; the old remote-session permission question is superseded. That new session has the complete handoff and handles local permission questions directly. No result from that session is claimed here.
- The [published evidence snapshot](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/6fe12f412cd74b034a77cde10a521bb319e8aa96/docs/qa/2026-11-16-macos-launcher/README.md) contains **1,296 raw files / 23,765,728 bytes**, now including selected sealed CI12/CI13 records, the test batch and isolated local build attempts, direct Mac QA08, actual Claude assessment09 and its root disposition. Root verified all source/destination pairs, staged raw objects and manifest/digest bytes; the original 1,181-row prefix is unchanged. Historical failed and cancelled runs retain their actual outcomes.

### Open delivery gates

Formal scans used: **2 of 3**. Independent GPT 6.1 Sol xhigh reviewed Claude's UI; actual Claude Code Opus 5.5 xhigh reviewed GPT's native/API implementation. Accepted corrections are implemented. Fresh independent Astra MAX final audit remains scan 3. Behavior QA and harness corrections do not reset that budget.

The owner approved **90% native Swift lines and 90% regions, plus explicit branch-outcome tests**, because the Mac LLVM export and a deliberate missed-else probe expose no branch counters. The complete collector accounts for all six production targets and both executable entries, including 23 executable sources and two independently established declaration-only sources. No V8 thresholds change. CI12 was below the native region requirement; CI13 establishes a complete passing result at `4d725033`. In historical CI14 attempt 1, the native coverage gate passed at the documentation/evidence head while its separate dependency audit failed; attempt 2 subsequently passed that audit.

The owner clarified the approved plan to use the existing authenticated shutdown API, with no new browser shutdown control. Existing browser Wait/Force choices apply after an externally initiated drain. Both decisions are [recorded on #456](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/issues/456#issuecomment-6935644999).

**Historical audit-blocker assessment, superseded by CI14 attempt 2 and #503's resolution above:**

> CI14's dependency-audit failure remains a merge blocker. [GHSA-fc5q-39xc-vjpf](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-fc5q-39xc-vjpf) was reviewed/updated November 17 and affects picomatch <=4.0.7, with no patched release currently listed. The locked version is 4.0.7. Read-only investigation establishes development/build/test dependency roots, including non-test tooling; that does not satisfy docs/10's test-only acceptance condition or establish shipped-code unreachability. No exemption, audit threshold change, dependency mutation or CI rerun was made. [#503](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/issues/503) records the evidence and conforming-resolution requirements separately from the original batch and successor scope.

Remaining actual Finder/Dock/default-browser/lifecycle observations and the final independent audit are still required. This PR remains draft. PR #460 and the owner Windows instance/store remain protected.

**Historical Mac-first sequencing, superseded by the owner's explicit amendment linked above:**

> The owner also approved the [next five-intent sequence](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/6fe12f412cd74b034a77cde10a521bb319e8aa96/docs/delivery/2026-11-17-five-intents-register.md), starting strictly after this PR completes its engineering gates and merges. The 26 core issues, two bounded diagnostics and conditional refinement scope are recorded without early implementation or issue un-parking. The [owner-acceptance readiness draft](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/6fe12f412cd74b034a77cde10a521bb319e8aa96/docs/delivery/2026-11-17-owner-acceptance-readiness.md) binds no installed build yet and schedules no deployment or owner session.

### Post-merge owner acceptance

Keep #456 and #326 open until the owner records the merged build and observations:

- Cold-launch from Finder and a retained Dock pin; expect one matching instance and the default browser.
- Reopen while running and launching; expect existing state with no duplicate start.
- Judge progress, Hide/reopen, Quit timing, keyboard/focus and failure guidance on the owner's setup.
- Close the launcher and browser during work; expect work to continue. Deliberate shutdown and later relaunch must preserve history; initiation uses the existing authenticated shutdown API.
- Update the managed app and exercise the retained alias/pin again.

Owner observations remain separate from technical verification and never waive an engineering gate.
